runtime_profile_summary: Node.js 20+ environment with npm package manager, Jest test framework, and git-lfs for model downloads. Configured with --ignore-scripts to skip onnxruntime-node GPU binary download.
notes: Transformers.js benchmark environment successfully created. Node.js v24.16.0 and npm 11.13.0 are available. Jest test runner is reachable and can discover tests. git-lfs is installed for model downloads. Fixed runtime_setup_failure (ConnectTimeoutError for onnxruntime-node GPU binary) by using --ignore-scripts flag during npm install to skip the postinstall script that downloads the GPU binary. CPU-only inference is supported via onnxruntime-web's WASM fallback.
